case.title: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series

message.subject: Re: Quote from Drehteile Fuchsreiter GmbH: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
message.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

Thank you for your quick quotation for the HX pump shaft. We value the years of reliable cooperation between our two family companies and would like to keep this part with you.

To be open with you, we have other offers on the table:

Another supplier has offered EUR 31.50 for this part (offer:70240-0).

Another supplier has offered EUR 36.00 for this part (offer:70210-0).

We would rather find a fair solution with you than move elsewhere. So we have prepared three genuine options, each with a different payment term, so you can choose what suits your business best:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 31.85; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 30.92; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 31.64; payment 30 days net; lead time 35 days.

We look forward to hearing which option works for you.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

Before we settle the terms, two points from our data matter to us:

Your on-time delivery was 62.5% in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70240@2026Q3).

With this in mind, we have prepared three options. Each offers clear planning security for both sides, and you can choose the payment and price balance that suits you best:

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 28.85; payment 60 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option B: unit price EUR 28.01; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.
Option C: unit price EUR 28.75; payment 45 days net; lead time 35 days.

We look forward to your choice and to a good start together.

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
